intent: A nested action menu for a document: commands, submenus that survive a diagonal hover path through a safe triangle, checkbox and radio items, mono shortcuts and a destructive item set apart, with the full APG menu keyboard model and typeahead. Monochrome, one accent on ticks and the radio dot.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@container, CSS variables, arbitrary values)
stack.animation: motion/react (variants, layoutId, pathLength, AnimatePresence, useReducedMotion), lucide-react icons at 15px stroke 1.75

layout.trigger: 40px (44px coarse), radius 10px, inset hairline, file icon, 14px/500 label, chevron that rotates 180 degrees when open
layout.menu: 8px below the trigger, anchored to its start or end edge, width prop (default 256, capped at 100vw - 32px), radius 12px, 6px padding, inset hairline, layered shadow
layout.submenu: 224px, 4px beside the menu, first row aligned with its trigger row, slides up when it would overflow the viewport bottom
layout.rows: 32px (44px coarse), radius 7px, 16px leading slot for icon, tick or dot, 13.5px label truncating, trailing mono shortcut, status or chevron plus ticked count
layout.headings: mono 10.5px uppercase, tracking 0.14em, muted; full-bleed hairline separators with 6px space
layout.destructive: last, after a separator: red label, icon and tinted shortcut, a muted 11.5px second line naming the consequence, 44px tall
layout.direction: submenus cascade away from the aligned edge and flip when out of room; with no room either side they drill in place with a Back row and an animated surface height
layout.container: @container on each menu surface; shortcuts hide below 208px (@max-[13rem])

typography.row: 13.5px, leading 20px, body colour, ink when highlighted
typography.heading: mono 10.5px uppercase, tracking 0.14em

color.tokens: PALETTE dark and light written to --dm-* variables; accent prop overrides the per-theme default
color.dark: stage #09090b, trigger #141416 (hover #1a1a1d), surface #121214, submenu #151518, ink #f4f4f5, body #d0d0d6, muted #8b8b94, hairline 8% white, highlight 7.5% white, danger #ff7a70 (highlight 13%), accent #8fb0ff
color.light: stage #f3f3f0, surfaces #ffffff, ink #18181b, body #3a3a41, muted #6b6b74, hairline 9% ink, highlight 5.5% ink, danger #c8321f (highlight 8%), accent #2f5bd3
color.rules: accent only on ticks and the radio dot; red only on the destructive row; everything else grey

motion.reveal: trigger rises 8px out of a 6px blur, 500ms ease-out [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]; the menu then opens on first view
motion.menuOpen: scale 0.96 to 1, 4px rise, 4px blur clearing, 220ms ease-out from the anchored corner; rows stagger 14ms with a 3px drop; close 140ms ease-in
motion.submenu: 6px slide out from its row with a 3px blur, 180ms; exit 110ms
motion.highlight: one layoutId element per menu on spring.ui (500/40); tint fades to red on the destructive row; open submenu row keeps a quieter mark
motion.tick: pathLength 0 to 1 over 280ms whenever an item turns on
motion.radio: 7px dot with a shared layoutId so it travels between options
motion.select: action row blinks once over 150ms, then the menu closes and focus returns to the trigger; checkable items keep the menu open
motion.count: ticked-children count cross-fades with a 7px rise
motion.safeArea: optional dashed triangle with 6% fill while the grace path is active
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only, 150ms or less, no stagger, no blink, spring jumps, tick pre-drawn

responsive.wide: submenus cascade to the side away from the aligned edge, flipping when there is no room
responsive.narrow: when neither side fits, submenus open in place as pages with a Back row; surface height animates between pages
responsive.touch: 44px trigger and rows on coarse pointers; no hover-only action, every submenu opens on click or tap

accessibility: trigger aria-haspopup menu, aria-expanded, aria-controls while open; focus-visible ring 2px ink at 60% offset 2px

role menu labelled by the trigger or its submenu row; rows menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio with aria-checked; submenu rows aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls; aria-disabled on disabled rows
headings label role group containers; separators role separator
Enter, Space, ArrowDown open on the first item; ArrowUp opens on the last
ArrowUp and ArrowDown wrap, Home End PageUp PageDown jump, disabled rows skipped
the arrow toward a submenu opens it on its first item; the opposite arrow returns to its row
Escape closes the innermost level and finally returns focus to the trigger; Tab closes and continues from the trigger
typeahead with a 500ms buffer; a repeated letter cycles
keyboard use adds a 1px inset ring to the highlight
polite live region announces toggles and actions

content.items: Open in new tab ⌘↵, Rename… ⌘R, Duplicate ⌘D, Move to (Halden Studio: Inbox, Q4 launch CURRENT disabled, Campaigns 2026, Archive, New folder… ⌘⇧N), Labels (Design review ticked, Needs copy, Urgent, Waiting on client, Legal hold, Manage labels…), Share (Copy link ⌘L, Invite people… ⌘I, Export as PDF ⌘⇧E), View (Show comments ⌘⇧C ticked, Word count ⌘⇧W), Page width (Readable ⌘1 chosen, Full width ⌘2), Delete brief ⌘⌫ with 'Removes it for 6 collaborators'
content.demo: the menu is open; the cursor rests on Labels until its submenu opens, then moves diagonally down to Waiting on client across Share and the View heading while the safe triangle keeps Labels open, ticks it (the count on Labels goes from 1 to 2), presses Escape twice to close the submenu and then the menu, and clicks the trigger to open it again

avoid: glass, gradients, glow or a radius above 12px
coloured icon tiles or accent on the highlight or trigger
closing a submenu as soon as the pointer crosses a sibling row
opening a submenu on the first pixel of hover
a destructive item in the same voice as the rest
unaligned labels when some rows have icons and others ticks
menus that run off the viewport on a phone instead of drilling in place
closing the menu on every checkbox toggle
robustness: The actual focused row owns keyboard activation. Keep its highlight synchronized when assistive technology, pointer movement or script changes focus; never activate a stale highlighted row.
